text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，完善煤炭跨区调运格局，持续优化“西煤东运”“北煤南运”运输体系，提升煤炭跨区调运能力。东南沿海地区国内供应以山西、蒙西、陕北基地为主，通过大秦、朔黄、瓦日等通道运至北方港口下水调入，合理利用进口煤保障供应。“两湖一江”（湖北、湖南、江西）地区重点通过浩吉、焦柳等通道及铁水联运网络，从蒙西、陕北、山西基地调入。东北地区主要依托蒙东基地供应，少量从蒙西、山西基地调入。西南地区立足本区域供应，部分通过西康、兰渝等通道从陕北、蒙西基地调入，稳步提升从新疆基地调入比例。
text_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration have issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Coal Industry Development.' It states that the cross-regional coal transportation pattern will be improved, with continued optimization of the 'West-to-East Coal Transport' and 'North-to-South Coal Transport' systems to enhance cross-regional coal shipping capacity. For the southeast coastal regions, domestic supply will primarily come from the Shanxi, Western Inner Mongolia, and Northern Shaanxi bases, shipped via corridors such as Daqin, Shuohuang, and Watang to northern ports for onward delivery, with imported coal used rationally to secure supply. For the 'Two Lakes and One River' region (Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi), supply will mainly come from the Western Inner Mongolia, Northern Shaanxi, and Shanxi bases via corridors such as Haoji and Jiaoliu, as well as rail-water intermodal networks. The northeast region will rely mainly on the Eastern Inner Mongolia base, with small amounts from the Western Inner Mongolia and Shanxi bases. The southwest region will rely on local supply, with partial inflows from the Northern Shaanxi and Western Inner Mongolia bases via corridors such as Xikang and Lanyu, while steadily increasing the proportion of supply from the Xinjiang base.
